history.summary: The Shree Geeta Bhawan Mandir is the famous Hindu temple of Moga, documented on the official District Moga government portal (moga.nic.in). It stands on the south corner of the city in Vedant Nagar (Geeta Bhawan Road). The temple holds daily aarti at 11:00 AM and 7:00 PM, with weekly poojas for Balaji on Sunday mornings and for Durga Maa on Tuesday evenings; an idol of Durga Mata and a Geeta Bhawan garden are noted attractions. No founder or construction date is published on the sources consulted. CSV town (Moga), district and state are correct. A separate Geeta Bhawan listing on Justdial ('Geeta Bhawan', Moga Road near Kashmiri Park, near Chokhra Palace) appears to be a different/duplicate listing - do not conflate. Media uses the photograph from the official moga.nic.in tourist-place page for this temple, verified by preflight.

name: Shri Geeta Bhawan Mandir
town_description: Moga is a city and district headquarters in central Punjab, on NH 5 between Ludhiana and Firozpur. The temple stands in Vedant Nagar (Geeta Bhawan Road) on the south side of the city, about 3 km from the Moga bus stand.

travel.airport: Nearest airports are at Mohali (about 159 km) and Chandigarh (about 169 km), per moga.nic.in.
travel.railway: Moga railway station (Northern Railway), well connected with Firozpur, Ludhiana, Chandigarh, Ambala, Delhi, New Delhi and Jaipur; served by trains such as Cdg Fzr Express, Asr Ajmer Express and Ajmer Asr Express (per moga.nic.in).
travel.road: In the south of Moga city; about 3 km from the bus stand (per moga.nic.in).
